The '''''Flare''''' was a modified [[Kuat Leisure]] [[121-B]] pleasure craft used by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Ylenic It'kla]] during their [[Mission to Corellia (Clone Wars)|mission]] to rescue [[Ratri Tane]], in the first months of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
